properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 family implementations) pinned in yarn.lock as a transitive dependency of the Ethereum toolchain. No direct call site found in application code under packages/; presence in the shipped dependency tree is the inventory fact. Changeable here by dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency inventory: md5@2.3.0 pinned in yarn.lock (transitive). MD5 is collision-broken, so its presence in the shipped tree is posture-relevant even without a direct app call site. Changeable here by removing/upgrading the dependent package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA is THE account/transaction-signing curve of this Ethereum dApp — the core quantum-vulnerable (Shor-broken) primitive. It reaches application code through ethers v6 (hardhat scripts: Wallet.createRandom/encrypt) and viem 2.57.3 (frontend, keccak + signing). Observable here, but not unilaterally replaceable: the secp256k1 curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 available in the shipped tree via @noble/curves (transitive; typically consumed by WalletConnect/JOSE token handling in the wallet stack, not directly by app code). No direct app call site found; presence recorded. Changeable here by dependency management.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same logical Keccak-256 implementation as the in-use site in contract.ts (viem delegates keccak256 to @noble/hashes); the lockfile declaration records the version of the hashing library the shipped build actually contains. Kept as the declaration-tier entry alongside the use-tier object ALG-052c24b2.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD available in the shipped dependency tree (transitive via the wallet/Web3 stack). Quantum-safe symmetric crypto; no direct app call site found. Changeable here by dependency management.

Changeable here by dependency upgrade.
